ridge.evaluation: single official test evaluation after freezing

tree.input: frozen SSLTemporalEncoder latents (d=32), seed-42 RCMKN UWaveY checkpoint, TRAIN samples pooled (761 x 315 = 239715 vectors)
tree.child_rule: binary path ids 2p/2p+1; bit-0 = lower first-centroid coordinate

chain.excluded_regimes: no invented PPVs; excluded from weighted energy
chain.support: occupied finest-regime (S16); nested so coarse exclusions vacuous

null.scheme: per-sample permutation of level-16 regime sequence (occupancy multiset preserved); identical estimator

stopping.rule: keep level iff real E_l > null p95 AND q < 0.05; stop at first failure; coarse to fine

budget.allocation: w_l = E_l / sum retained E_l; largest-remainder integer rounding, tie-break lower K first
budget.selection: top e_{m,c,l} = mean_i pi_c Delta^2 per level; ties by (kernel, child id); label-free
